description:
I'm Sal Whitaker. I've been fixing cars for over forty years. Twelve of them inside a dealership service department, and thirty running my own shop right here in East Tennessee.

I started this channel because I got tired of watching good people get scared into repairs they never needed. Somebody walks into a shop with a funny noise and walks out with a twelve-hundred-dollar quote — and half the time, it's for stuff their car won't need for years, if ever.

So here's what I do here. I show you what's actually going on under the hood. What that noise really is. Which repairs matter and which ones are just padding on an estimate. How to talk to a mechanic so you don't get taken. And how to keep a car running long past the point most folks give up on it — without emptying your wallet doing it.

Take care of the car, and it'll take care of you. See you at the shop.
